dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, crenulated 'O' and 'C' shaped structures display sharp transitions from dark exterior pixels to lighter grey interiors, with the most prominent annuli located along the mid-lateral axis exhibiting jagged, non-uniform perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low-to-moderate density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity white-grey pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily localized in the anterior neck region and sparsely interspersed between the larger annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest centrally-located annuli form an obtuse triangle; a series of smaller high-intensity blobs in the anterior section forms a roughly linear trajectory toward the head.

other_distinctive_markers: A bright red, rectangular-shaped electronic tag is fixed to the dorsal surface at the posterior end of the visible body section.
